description: Create a channel set — a saved channel grouping for one-click multi-channel targeting. Names are unique per organization (a duplicate fails with a 409, code DUPLICATE_NAME); an organization can have up to 50 sets. Use this when the user wants to save a group of channels for one-click targeting.

channelIds.description: IDs of channels in your organization (at least 1).

name.description: Set name (max 100 chars, unique per organization).

name: create_channel_set
title: Create channel set
